capabilities: Reorder frontmatter properties per folder using ordered templates
Sort properties in all matched notes or in the current note
Create missing template properties with empty values
Remove unlisted or empty properties from matched notes
Suggest property names from the vault metadata cache while typing
disambiguation: Not a note or file organizer; it only reorders (and optionally creates or removes) frontmatter properties.
extras: Warns that unlisted-property removal is destructive (a root fallback template with Remove all can strip all frontmatter); frontmatter YAML formatting may be normalized by Obsidian and comments may not survive; requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; works on mobile with sequential processing.
problem: Obsidian writes frontmatter properties in whatever order they were added, with no way to enforce a consistent property order across folders.

relations.evidence: Scaffolded and reviewed with the help of the obsidian-plugin-skill for Claude.

summary: Frontmatter property organizer that reorders YAML properties in notes according to per-folder templates, on demand or once at vault startup.
